LPG safety tips
  • Store tanks upright in a ventilated area, away from heat.
  • Check hoses and regulator for cracks. Test connections with soapy water.
  • If you smell gas: don't switch anything on, open windows, close the valve, and call us.

FAQ

What areas do you deliver to?

We serve nearby barangays and cities. Message us your address to confirm and get the delivery fee.

How fast is delivery?

Usually within 1–2 hours during business hours, subject to rider availability.

Why do you need my ID and selfie?

It protects customers and riders from fake orders. Your photos are used only to verify your order.

Do I need to give an empty tank?

For a refill, yes. Our rider swaps your empty tank for a full one.

What are your hours?

Open daily, 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM.
